bands.PARA: direct structural context: parent/children of the focused aperture
bands.PERIPHERY: same-aperture sibling/background routes; subdetail suppressed, topology retained

benchmark.goal: focus Scale Lens Studio and confirm its address/state
identify containing aperture and one same-aperture peer without losing focus
VISUAL → STRUCTURE → VISUAL, preserve identity, then RETURN to entry UI state

measurement.protocol: Run each task PLAIN and FOVEATED; alternate condition order across at least three passes. The bench applies condition/setup before timing and keeps receipts browser-local until explicit COPY.

bench.exports: 0xxx0/lens-proof-packet/v0.1 JSON copied explicitly by the human

promotion_gate: Identity continuity must be 100% in both conditions.
FOVEATED must reduce median actionCount or duration for at least one context-heavy task without increasing wrong-route selections.
If no advantage appears, keep foveation experimental and retain the plain baseline.
unverified: formal paired three-pass metrics; not required to withhold promotion
exact historical red-dot RSVP/foveated reader remains unrecovered
return: LENS-03 did not earn promotion in the initial human trial. Keep PLAIN as baseline/default; retain field-foveate as a parked optional donor and comparator only. Reopen only for a concrete task failure, not to seek significance.

human_result.observation: User tried PLAIN and FOVEATED and reported nothing notable, obvious, or self-evidently better.
human_result.rationale: The treatment did not clear the first and most important usefulness threshold: a perceptible task or orientation advantage. Do not amplify the effect merely to manufacture a win.

promotion_decision.revisit_only_if: a concrete context-heavy task exposes a plain-baseline deficiency that the foveation mechanism plausibly addresses
